summary: Defined the submodule cleanup halt envelope contract and force retry failure behavior.

items.title: Submodule halt envelope contract is undefined
items.rationale: Added dedicated submodule cleanup halt codes, required bounded data fields, recovery options, and diagnostic granularity.
items.evidence: spec.json constraints, requirements R4/R7/R9, acceptance_criteria, clarifications, and overview.decisions now define `SUBMODULE_WORKTREE_DIRTY` and `SUBMODULE_WORKTREE_STATUS_FAILED` contracts.

items.title: Force retry failure path is omitted
items.rationale: Specified that a failed clean-confirmed force retry returns a dedicated halt envelope and does not proceed to branch deletion.
items.evidence: spec.json data_flow, requirements R3/R8/R9, acceptance_criteria, clarifications, and task acceptance now cover `SUBMODULE_WORKTREE_FORCE_REMOVE_FAILED` and branch deletion ordering.
